name: Hands On Nashville Youth and Teen Volunteering
org: Hands On Nashville (United Way of Greater Nashville)
what_you_do: Sign up for volunteer projects around Nashville through a Hands On account. Your hours are tracked, and you can use them for school service credit.
who_can_apply: People 13 and older can have a Hands On account. Each project has its own age rule, so check the listing. Kids under 13 volunteer through the family page.
deadline_text: No deadline. Pick projects as they are posted.
how_to_apply: Make a Hands On account and sign up for a project. A parent or guardian must sign the Hands On waiver. Bring the waiver to the project and check in with the Volunteer Leader.
notes: For school credit, bring your school's form. Ask the volunteer coordinator to check your hours.
